title: Reported Speech: Change of Pronouns — Quiz 126
content:
## Reported Speech: Change of Pronouns

Select the right pronoun when the speaker or listener changes.

### Lesson focus

1. The doctor said to me, “You should take rest.”
2. He said to her, “You are smart.”
3. Father said to me, “I'm proud of you.”

### Practise with the image

Read the full lesson image for the original exercise, notes and any answer key shown. Write your own answers before checking a key. A key labelled for another quiz belongs to that quiz.
